description: Code Intelligence Integration evals — auto-detection, per-tool TTL, lock, freshness, migration, agent injection, graceful degradation, concurrency

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Both GitNexus + Serena available. Test: cache miss (first run), MCP tools accessible.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 (no args): exit 0, JSON status=needs_scan hoac all_fresh. Phase 2 (--write-cache): exit 0, cache co gitnexus.available=true, serena.available=true, per-tool checked_at + ttl_hours va gitnexus.repo khac unknown.

assertions.text: ci-detect.sh (Phase 1) exit 0 — signal skill agent correctly
Cache: gitnexus.checked_at co gia tri ISO 8601, khong rong
Cache: serena.checked_at co gia tri ISO 8601, khong rong
Cache: gitnexus.repo khac unknown (resolved from git remote)

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Only GitNexus available, Serena NOT available. Test: simulate GitNexus-only MCP environment.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh --write-cache exit 0 (GitNexus available). Cache: gitnexus.available=true, serena.available=false, serena.ttl_hours=1.

assertions.text: ci-detect.sh --write-cache exit 0 — at least GitNexus available

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Only Serena available, GitNexus NOT available. Test: simulate Serena-only MCP environment.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh --write-cache exit 0 (Serena available). Cache: gitnexus.available=false, gitnexus.ttl_hours=4, serena.available=true.

assertions.text: ci-detect.sh --write-cache exit 0 — at least Serena available

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Neither GitNexus nor Serena available. Test: simulate no-CI MCP environment.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh --write-cache exit 1 (no CI tools). Cache: both.available=false. ci-inject-context.sh exit 1. Agent context NOT injected.

assertions.text: ci-detect.sh --write-cache exit 1 — no CI tools available
ci-inject-context.sh exit 1 — no context to inject
Agent spawn prompt does NOT contain 'Code Intelligence' section

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Serena absent, TTL=1h expired. Test: set serena.checked_at > 1h ago, serena.available=false.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh Phase 1: JSON status=needs_scan (Serena TTL stale). Re-detect Serena. Cache updated: serena.checked_at moi > cu, serena.ttl_hours moi.

assertions.text: Serena checked_at cu > 1h ago → stale → re-scan triggered
After re-scan: serena.checked_at updated to current time

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — GitNexus present, TTL=24h valid. Test: set gitnexus.checked_at within 24h, gitnexus.available=true.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh Phase 1: JSON status=all_fresh (both within TTL). Skip MCP detection. Cache unchanged.

assertions.text: GitNexus checked_at < 24h ago → fresh → skip re-scan
Cache file gitnexus.checked_at unchanged after ci-detect (no re-write)

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — GitNexus absent, TTL=4h expired. Test: set gitnexus.checked_at > 4h ago, gitnexus.available=false.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh Phase 1: JSON status=needs_scan (GitNexus TTL stale). Re-detect GitNexus. Cache updated: gitnexus.checked_at moi.

assertions.text: GitNexus checked_at > 4h ago (absent) → stale → re-scan triggered
After re-scan: gitnexus.checked_at updated, ttl_hours per new availability

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — MCV3_CI_RESCAN=1 force re-scan. Test: set env var, both tools within TTL.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh Phase 1: JSON status=needs_scan (env var forces re-scan). Stderr: 'MCV3_CI_RESCAN=1 — forcing re-scan'.

assertions.text: MCV3_CI_RESCAN=1 triggers re-scan even when all_fresh
ci-detect.sh acquires lock before re-scan (respects concurrency)

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Lock acquired successfully. Test: clean state, no existing lock.
evals.expected_output: Lock acquired. Lock file .mc-data/work/_meta/.ci-cache.lock ton tai voi format PID|host|user|acquired_at|heartbeat_at.

assertions.text: Lock file created via atomic noclobber
Lock file has 5 fields separated by |

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Lock held by another session. Test: create valid lock file (heartbeat < 60s ago), run ci-detect.sh.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh exit 2. JSON status=lock_held, action=fallback_grep. Lock file unchanged (not broken). Skill uses Grep, khong block.

assertions.text: ci-detect.sh exit 2 — lock held by another session
Lock file NOT modified (not broken when valid)
Lock file NOT deleted (still held by active session)
Skill agent falls back to Grep — zero regression

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Stale lock > 60 giay. Test: create lock file with heartbeat_at > 60s ago.
evals.expected_output: ci-detect.sh breaks stale lock. Stderr: 'Breaking stale lock (>60s)'. New lock acquired. Cache scanned + written. Lock released.

assertions.text: New lock file created with current PID|host|user
ci-detect.sh exit 0 (not exit 2 — lock NOT treated as valid)
Cache scanned successfully after breaking stale lock

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — 2 terminal dong thoi (cache miss). Test: Terminal 1 acquires lock first, Terminal 2 arrives during scan.
evals.expected_output: Terminal 1: acquire lock → scan MCP → write cache → release lock. Terminal 2: lock held → exit 2 → fallback Grep. Cache file valid JSON, khong corrupt.

assertions.text: Terminal 1 acquires lock → runs CI tools → writes cache → releases lock
Terminal 2: lock held → ci-detect.sh exit 2 → fallback Grep/Glob
Terminal 2 does NOT wait for lock — immediate fallback
Cache file is valid JSON (jq -e passes) after Terminal 1 writes
Cache file NOT corrupt — both gitnexus and serena fields present

evals.prompt: ci-freshness-check.sh — HEAD == index_commit. Test: set cache index_commit = git rev-parse HEAD.
evals.expected_output: ci-freshness-check.sh exit 0. JSON status=ok, behind=0.

evals.prompt: ci-freshness-check.sh — HEAD ahead by 3 commits. Test: set index_commit 3 commits behind HEAD.
evals.expected_output: ci-freshness-check.sh exit 1. JSON status=warning, level=light, behind=3. Message includes 'may miss recent changes'.

evals.prompt: ci-freshness-check.sh — HEAD ahead by 15 commits. Test: set index_commit 15 commits behind HEAD.
evals.expected_output: ci-freshness-check.sh exit 2. JSON status=warning, level=strong, behind=15. Message: 'significantly behind (15 commits). Consider: gitnexus analyze'.

evals.prompt: ci-freshness-check.sh — HEAD ahead by 50 commits. Test: set index_commit 50 commits behind HEAD.
evals.expected_output: ci-freshness-check.sh exit 3. JSON status=warning, level=severe, behind=50. Message: 'likely incomplete. Recommend re-index before continuing'.

assertions.text: Message includes 'likely incomplete' and 're-index before continuing'

evals.prompt: ci-freshness-check.sh — index_commit missing in cache. Test: cache has gitnexus.available=true but index_commit field empty/null.
evals.expected_output: ci-freshness-check.sh exit 0. JSON status=unknown, reason='index_commit missing in cache'. Skip gracefully, khong block.

assertions.text: JSON status=unknown, reason='index_commit missing in cache'
Does NOT block execution — zero regression

evals.prompt: ci-freshness-check.sh — Not a git repo. Test: run outside git repo (ex: non-git project dir).
evals.expected_output: ci-freshness-check.sh exit 0. JSON status=skipped, reason='not a git repository'. Short-circuit ngay lap tuc.

assertions.text: JSON status=skipped, reason='not a git repository'
Exits immediately without checking cache file

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Cache schema v1 detected. Test: create cache file with schema_version=1, gitnexus.available, serena.available but no per-tool TTL fields.
evals.expected_output: Stderr: 'Cache schema v1 detected — forcing re-scan for v2 migration'. Old cache removed. New cache written in v2 schema with all required fields.

assertions.text: Stderr contains 'Cache schema v1 detected — forcing re-scan for v2 migration'
New cache has gitnexus.ttl_hours and serena.ttl_hours
New cache has gitnexus.index_commit (khong co trong v1)

evals.prompt: ci-inject-context.sh — Both tools available, index fresh. Test: cache with gitnexus.available=true, serena.available=true, ci-freshness-check.sh exit 0.
evals.expected_output: ci-inject-context.sh exit 0. Output: Both-OK template. Contains 'GitNexus + Serena' title. Contains repo name, symbols, flows. Content < 600 chars. NO freshness warning.

assertions.text: Output contains '## Code Intelligence: GitNexus + Serena'

evals.prompt: ci-inject-context.sh — Both tools + freshness SEVERE (>20 behind). Test: cache with both available, ci-freshness-check.sh exit 3 (severe).
evals.expected_output: ci-inject-context.sh exit 0. Output: Both-Stale template. Contains 'WARNING' + severity level. Contains 'Serena (real-time, unaffected by index)'. Content < 700 chars.

evals.prompt: ci-inject-context.sh — GitNexus-only + freshness LIGHT (1-5 behind). Test: cache gitnexus.available=true, serena.available=false, ci-freshness-check.sh exit 1.
evals.expected_output: ci-inject-context.sh exit 0. Output: GitNexus template. Contains 'gitnexus_impact' + 'gitnexus_query' + 'gitnexus_rename' guidance. Contains freshness light warning. Content < 500 chars.

assertions.text: Output contains '## Code Intelligence: GitNexus' (not '+ Serena')

evals.prompt: ci-inject-context.sh — Serena-only. Test: cache gitnexus.available=false, serena.available=true. ci-freshness-check.sh exit 0 (skipped — no gitnexus).
evals.expected_output: ci-inject-context.sh exit 0. Output: Serena template. Contains 'real-time, always current'. Contains 'find_definition', 'find_references', 'rename_symbol', 'get_symbols_overview'. NO freshness warning. Content < 400 chars.

assertions.text: Output contains '## Code Intelligence: Serena' (not GitNexus)
Output does NOT contain 'WARNING' (Serena is real-time)

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — No CI tools available. Test: ci-detect.sh returns exit 1 (no_git or no tools), ci-inject-context.sh exit 1.
evals.expected_output: All skills fallback to Grep/Glob. No ERROR emitted. Skill execution continues binh thuong. Zero regression.

assertions.text: Skill uses Grep/Glob (current behavior, zero regression)
No ERROR message about missing CI tools

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Lock held → fallback. Test: concurrent lock scenario, ci-detect exit 2.
evals.expected_output: Skill uses Grep/Glob instead of CI tools. Does NOT wait for lock. Does NOT attempt MCP calls. Zero regression — same behavior as pre-CI integration.

assertions.text: ci-detect.sh exit 2 → skill reads JSON action=fallback_grep
Skill does NOT block or wait for lock release
Skill falls back to Grep/Glob seamlessly
No MCP tool calls attempted (no gitnexus_* or serena_* tools used)

evals.prompt: ci-detect.sh — Cache corrupt. Test: create cache file with invalid JSON (e.g., truncated).
evals.expected_output: Stderr: 'Corrupt cache file detected — removing for re-scan'. Old cache deleted. Fresh scan performed. New valid cache written.

assertions.text: Stderr contains 'Corrupt cache file detected — removing for re-scan'
ci-detect.sh proceeds with fresh scan (not infinite loop)
New cache file is valid JSON (jq -e passes)
New cache has schema_version=2 with all required fields
